sample.source_text: A model overfits when it learns patterns that are specific to the training data but do not generalize to new samples. Regularization reduces this risk by penalizing unnecessary complexity, although excessive regularization can cause underfitting.

structured.explanation: 段落的核心关系是：模型在训练集上学到不适用于新数据的模式，就是过拟合。正则化通过限制或惩罚复杂模型来减少这种风险，体现的是控制复杂度以提高泛化能力的作用。不过，正则化并非越强越好；如果惩罚过多，模型会变得过于简单，从而欠拟合。
evidence: A model overfits when it learns patterns that are specific to the training data but do not generalize to new samples.
Regularization reduces this risk by penalizing unnecessary complexity
although excessive regularization can cause underfitting.

sample.source_text: Snapshot isolation gives each transaction a consistent view of committed data. It prevents many read anomalies, but concurrent transactions can still produce write skew when they update disjoint rows based on the same earlier snapshot.
sample.context_text: The passage distinguishes snapshot consistency from serializability.

structured.concise_meaning: 快照隔离让事务看到一致的已提交数据，能减少多种读取异常，但并发事务若基于同一较早快照更新不同行，仍可能发生写偏斜。
structured.explanation: 段落先说明快照隔离的作用，再指出其限制：即使每个事务看到的是稳定一致的已提交数据，并发更新不同行仍可能形成写偏斜。因此，快照一致性并不等同于排除所有并发写入异常。
evidence: Snapshot isolation gives each transaction a consistent view of committed data.
It prevents many read anomalies, but concurrent transactions can still produce write skew when they update disjoint rows based on the same earlier snapshot.

review.notes: correctly distinguishes consistency from write-skew protection
